_notes: NSE trading holidays used by data/expiry_calendar.py. An expiry that falls on a segment_closed holiday moves to the previous trading day.

Forward-looking only (on/after 2026-10-19) for 'holidays'. Historical exchange holidays that shifted an expiry before 2026-10-19 are listed separately under 'historical_expiry_closures' (derived from the NSE F&O archive, see tests/test_expiry_calendar_vs_archive.py); they do not affect the 'holidays' list.
Add each new exchange holiday list here every year and re-verify against the NSE holiday circular/API.
verified=true means confirmed against the official NSE holiday master (source field). verified=false means not confirmed; the entry is still applied.

Muhurat sessions are informational only (muhurat_session=true, segment_closed=false) and do not shift expiries by themselves. Diwali days on which the archive shows the expiry moved (2021-11-04, 2025-10-21) are listed under historical_expiry_closures.

holidays.name: Dussehra
holidays.notes: Tuesday. Weekly/monthly Tuesday expiry moves to Monday 2026-10-19.

holidays.name: Diwali Laxmi Pujan (Muhurat trading)
holidays.notes: Sunday. Muhurat session only, timings not yet notified by NSE. Informational; no expiry shift.

holidays.name: Diwali-Balipratipada
holidays.notes: Tuesday. Official NSE list says Tue 2026-11-10. Some third-party sources said Mon 2026-11-09; the official NSE list was followed. Weekly expiry moves to Monday 2026-11-09.

holidays.name: Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev
holidays.notes: Tuesday. Monthly expiry (last Tuesday of Nov 2026) moves to Monday 2026-11-23.
